title: [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] SIDESTORY: OPERATION ORIGINIUM DUST RERUN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] SIDESTORY: OPERATION ORIGINIUM DUST RERUN

DETAILS: Operation Originium Dust event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions to obtain rewards by clearing event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tachanka, Special Equipment Exhibition Room Furniture (Pieces), Rhodes Island Resource Allocation Certificate.

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Rhodes Island Resource Allocation Certificate by clearing event stages and missions in Combat Report. Rhodes Island Resource Allocation Certificate can be used to redeem items from Commissary.
MAIN REWARDS: Tachanka's Token, Special Equipment Exhibition Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
-This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

-The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
-[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
-Operators Ash, Tachanka, Blitz, and Frost will gain more trust during the event rerun.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPE N – ATTACK - DEFENCE - TACTICAL COLLIDE
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
-"Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide" is [Elite Tactical Headhunting].
-New Operators Ash, Frost and Blitz are currently ONLY available from "Attack, Defence, Tactical Collide" and will NOT appear in Standard Headhuntings or Kernel Headhuntings.
-Please refer to the official notice of this [Elite Tactical Headhunting] for more details.
03 [ ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] LIMITED-TIME PACK AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Sniper Dualchip *4, Sniper Chip *5, Skill Summary - 3 *45, Skill Summary - 2 *25, Skill Summary - 1 *10
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – SPECIAL EQUIPMENT EXHIBITION ROOM
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
